note: WhatsApp message templates the workflow sends. Create each one in Meta WhatsApp Manager under EXACTLY this name, language FLOWHQ_WA_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE (default en), and the body below ({{1}} = first param). The order of params is fixed by W12 (WA_TEMPLATES). Category is a proposal: Meta decides, and may re-classify (marketing templates cost more and need opt-in). hello_world is Meta's sample and is refused in production.
